job.value: Find the order they need to pay for

arrivedFrom.value: My purchases from the Me tab or a payment reminder

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My purchases' with the 'To Pay' tab and a 'Pending payment' card makes it clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The card has only a chevron; there is no 'Pay' button for the one thing the buyer must do.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Tabs are clear, but the card's chevron doesn't say it leads to payment.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Pending payment', 'To Pay' and 'In progress' are familiar.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The card shows only seller, item photo, count and total.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The total shows 'S$72.40' on a Taiwan order board where NT$ is expected.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and the total carry the card with no prose.
